user.title: SolarEdge One
user.description: Sign in with the same e-mail and password you use on monitoring.solaredge.com. The site ID is the siteId in the dashboard URL.

data_description.site_id: The number after siteId= in the dashboard URL (e.g. 1234567).
data_description.cookie: Only needed if Cloudflare blocks Home Assistant: the cookie header of a monitoring.solaredge.com request (contains cf_clearance).
data_description.user_agent: Must match the browser the cookie came from (Cloudflare ties cf_clearance to it).
